title: ShoppingListsView: search and create-list flow
description: Extend `ShoppingListsView.swift` with: (1) `.searchable` modifier (prompt "Search shopping lists") filtering card rows by case-insensitive name substring and showing a search-no-match empty state when active search yields nothing; (2) a floating action button (bottom-trailing `.borderedProminent` circle with `plus` icon, hidden when search is active); (3) the create-new-list `.alert` triggered by the FAB — name `TextField` (placeholder "Name (e.g., 'Weekend BBQ')"), disabled "Create" until non-empty, name sanitisation (trim + replace `/` with `-`), duplicate-name inline error, on success writes `# <name>\n` to disk, appends to in-memory list, and pushes the new list's detail view.
acceptance_criteria: Card rows filter by case-insensitive name substring during search
Search-no-match empty state shows `magnifyingglass` icon and "No matches" title
FAB is visible when search is inactive; hidden when search is active
FAB tap presents `.alert` with title "New shopping list" and a name TextField
"Create" button is disabled until name is non-empty after trimming whitespace
Name sanitisation: leading/trailing whitespace trimmed, `/` replaced with `-`
Duplicate file name shows inline error and retains the typed name for editing
Successful create writes `# <name>\n` file, appends entry to in-memory list, and auto-pushes the detail view

handoff_summary.completed: 1. Added .searchable modifier (prompt "Search shopping lists") on NavigationStack content. 2. filteredEntries computed property filters by case-insensitive name substring. 3. Search-no-match empty state shows magnifyingglass icon and "No matches" title when searchText is non-empty and filteredEntries is empty. 4. FAB (borderedProminent circle, plus icon, bottom-trailing) reads @Environment(\.isSearching) via ShoppingListsBody and hides when search is active. 5. FAB tap sets showingCreateAlert = true, presenting .alert titled "New shopping list" with a TextField (placeholder "Name (e.g., 'Weekend BBQ')"). 6. Create button disabled when trimmed name is empty. 7. handleCreate() sanitises: trim whitespace + replace / with -. 8. Duplicate file name sets duplicateNameError = true and re-presents alert with "A list with that name already exists." message; newListName retained. 9. On success: writes # <name>\n, prepends new ShoppingListEntry to entries, sets selectedURL to push detail view.
handoff_summary.remaining: ShoppingListDetailView (currently a stub) is not implemented in this bead — it belongs to a separate detail-view bead. The EmptyStateView subtitle for the no-match state is passed as empty string because EmptyStateView requires a non-optional subtitle; a future polish bead could add an optional subtitle parameter.
handoff_summary.risks: ShoppingListsBody passes filteredEntries and searchText from parent as let properties; if a future bead moves search state management, both must be kept in sync. The handleCreate() file I/O runs on the main actor — acceptable for small writes but worth noting.
handoff_summary.next_action: Tester agent should verify the search filter, FAB visibility toggle, duplicate-name error re-presentation, and successful create-and-navigate flow.
handoff_summary.conflict_risks: ShoppingListDetailView.swift is a stub; any bead that fills in that implementation should not conflict with this bead's changes since we only reference it via navigationDestination.
handoff_summary.design_decisions: Extracted inner ShoppingListsBody private struct so it can read @Environment(\.isSearching) — this value is only propagated to descendants of the .searchable modifier's host, making the split necessary. The alert re-presentation pattern (set showingCreateAlert = true inside the Create action after alert dismisses) is the standard SwiftUI approach for keeping an alert open after validation failure.
handoff_summary.test_coverage_notes: No tests were added in this bead (tests are the tester agent's responsibility). Key flows to test: search filtering, FAB hidden/visible toggle, alert TextField disabled state, duplicate detection, successful file write + navigation push.
handoff_summary.known_limitations: EmptyStateView requires a non-optional subtitle; the no-match empty state passes an empty string for subtitle, which renders a blank line. A polish bead could make subtitle optional.

conflict_risks: ShoppingListDetailView.swift is a stub; any bead that fills in that implementation should not conflict with this bead's changes since we only reference it via navigationDestination.
